Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-ares && mkdir -p /workspace/candidates && for f in clusterfuzz-5650695891451904 clusterfuzz-5651369832218624 clusterfuzz-5674462260756480 clusterfuzz-5680630672654336 clusterfuzz-5683497160671232 clusterfuzz-5687310655422464 clusterfuzz-5695341573177344 clusterfuzz-5697835103682560 clusterfuzz-5728518081609728 clusterfuzz-5732960017317888; do git show b949cc3:test/fuzzinput/$f > /workspace/candidates/$f; done && wc -c /workspace/candidates/* && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, os, glob
for path in glob.glob('/workspace/candidates/*'):
 data=open(path,'rb').read()
 if len(data)<12: continue
 qd,an=struct.unpack('!HH',data[4:8])
 print(os.path.basename(path), len(data), 'qd',qd,'an',an, 'hdr',data[:12].hex())
 # parse qname simple compression
 def name(off):
  labels=[]; start=off; jumped=False; end=None; seen=0
  while off < len(data) and seen<20:
   seen+=1; l=data[off]
   if l&0xc0==0xc0:
    if off+1>=len(data): return None,off+1
    ptr=((l&0x3f)<<8)|data[off+1]
    if end is None: end=off+2
    off=ptr; jumped=True; continue
   if l==0:
    off+=1; return b'.'.join(labels).decode('latin1','replace'), (end if end is not None else off)
   off+=1; labels.append(data[off:off+l]); off+=l
  return None,off
 off=12
 qname,off=name(off)
 print(' qname',qname,'off',off)
 if off+4<=len(data): print(' qtype,class',struct.unpack('!HH',data[off:off+4])); off+=4
 counts={}
 for i in range(an):
  rn,off2=name(off)
  if off2+10>len(data): print(' trunc at rr',i,off); break
  typ,cl,ttl,rdlen=struct.unpack('!HHIH',data[off2:off2+10]); rdata_off=off2+10
  counts[typ]=counts.get(typ,0)+1
  if i<10: print(' rr',i,'name',rn,'typ',typ,'cl',cl,'ttl',ttl,'rdlen',rdlen,'rdata',data[rdata_off:rdata_off+min(rdlen,16)].hex())
  off=rdata_off+rdlen
 print(' counts',counts, 'end',off)
PY` executed with exit code 0.
